_doc: Home page hero stats and the featured projects (portfolio cards). Edit by hand; home.js reads it with cache: no-cache. stats: [{v: big value, l: small label}]. featured (in display order, the first card is shown wide): title, kicker (small line above the title), desc, image (img/...), link (null = not clickable), cta (button text), badge (chip on the image), soon (true = greyed 'coming soon' card).
